pages.text: Life Energy is a high-tier form of energy, $(reset)independent of Akaishi Energy$(reset): it has its own pipes and tanks and can never be mixed with akaishi power — the $(l:akaishi:life_conversion)Life Conversion Matrix$(/l) is its only refinery.$(br2)A player's own Life Energy caps at a base of $(reset)1000$(reset) and $(bold)never regenerates on its own$(reset), so spend it carefully.$(br2)$(bold)Core use:$(reset) solidify it into $(reset)Life Essence Solids$(reset), the currency of the whole life line — see the $(l:akaishi:life_purifier)Life Energy Purifier$(/l).

$(bold)Storage:$(reset) Life Energy Cells come in tiers — Basic $(reset)1,000,000$(reset) (crafted) → Advanced $(reset)4,000,000$(reset) → Super $(reset)40,000,000$(reset), upgraded step by step with high-tier components. Every cell has a two-way buffer you can freely charge and drain: a backup storage system beside your power grid.$(br2)$(bold)Transport:$(reset) Life Energy Pipes carry Life Energy only and never mix with akaishi power pipes — connected wrong, they transfer nothing. Pipes come in four tiers (per-tick throughput): Basic $(reset)1000$(reset) → Intermediate $(reset)4000$(reset) → Advanced $(reset)16000$(reset) → Ultimate $(reset)64000$(reset), upgraded step by step as a cross of the previous tier x4 plus metal dust.

$(bold)Cell Serializer:$(reset) place 1 Life Energy Cell Serializer in the center and wrap it in an enclosed $(reset)3x3x3 shell of 26 Life Energy Cells$(reset) of any tier to form the structure (the core is hidden — right-click any shell cell to open its UI).$(br2)Once formed, the 26 shell cells and the core combine into a single pooled buffer whose capacity adds up per cell; attach a pipe to any shell to charge or drain the whole structure. Breaking it apart keeps each cell's own energy safe.
Read "$(l:akaishi:life_path)The Path of Life Research$(/l)" first. How it is produced and consumed: see the Matrix and the Purifier.
